description: This file defines the IBMGuardrailDetector class, which implements a custom guardrail for use with large language models. It integrates with IBM's Guardrails API (both server and orchestrator modes) to analyze text inputs and model responses for violations based on configured detectors. The class provides methods for calling the external API, filtering detections by threshold, and hooks for pre-validation, moderation, and post-processing of LLM interactions.

classes.name: IBMGuardrailDetector
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that interacts with IBM Guardrails API to detect content violations during LLM operations. Supports both server and orchestrator modes, provides methods for API communication, detection filtering, and integrates with LLM call hooks for pre, during, and post-processing.

methods.name: List[List[IBMDetectorDetection]] _call_detector_server( self, contents: List[str], request_data: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous HTTP POST request to the IBM detector server with provided contents to receive detection results.

methods.name: List[IBMDetectorDetection] _call_orchestrator( self, content: str, request_data: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Calls the IBM FMS Guardrails orchestrator API with a single content string to obtain detection outcomes.

methods.name: List[IBMDetectorDetection] _filter_detections_by_threshold( self, detections: List[IBMDetectorDetection] )
methods.description: Filters a list of detections based on the score threshold, returning only those above or equal to the threshold.

methods.name: GuardrailStatus _determine_guardrail_status_detector_server( self, response_json: List[List[IBMDetectorDetection]] )
methods.description: Determines guardrail status ('success', 'guardrail_intervened', or 'guardrail_failed_to_respond') based on detector server detection results.

methods.name: GuardrailStatus _determine_guardrail_status_orchestrator( self, response_json: IBMDetectorResponseOrchestrator )
methods.description: Determines guardrail status based on the orchestrator's detection response.

methods.name: str _create_error_message_detector_server( self, detections_list: List[List[IBMDetectorDetection]] )
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message string summarizing detection violations from detector server responses.

methods.name: str _create_error_message_orchestrator( self, detections: List[IBMDetectorDetection] )
methods.description: Creates a detailed error message summarizing detection violations from orchestrator responses.

methods.description: Pre-LLM call hook that analyzes input messages and blocks requests if violations are detected based on the detector or orchestrator results.

methods.description: Parallel-to-LLM call hook that can reject or accept an input without modifying it, based on guardrail detections.
